description: List the available option expiration dates for a stock, with the contract count at each. Use this to pick an expiration for GetOptionChain. Pass expired=true for past expirations (US tickers), to pick one for GetOptionChainSession. For a TSX/TSXV listing or an NSE share or index pass MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY, XNSE:NIFTY.

endDate.description: With expired=true: last expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: yesterday)

expired.description: List past expirations instead of upcoming ones (default: false)

startDate.description: With expired=true: first expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: 90 days before endDate)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, or MIC:TICKER for a TSX or TSXV listing or an NSE share or index, e.g. XTSE:RY, XNSE:NIFTY

name: GetOptionExpirations
title: Option Expirations
